listingTitle: Avoid removing the front of Dart lists in loops
title: Avoid removing the front of Dart lists in loops
why: List.removeAt(0) shifts every remaining element, so repeated front removal can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Advance an index through the list or use ListQueue when queue semantics are required.
limitations: Only directly declared List variables removed at literal index zero inside recognized loops are reported.
Aliases, collection size, loop bounds, and intentionally small lists are not inferred.
